annotations.desc: First committed step of strigolactone biosynthesis; isomerises all-trans- to 9-cis-beta-carotene.
Carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase 7 acting on 9-cis-beta-carotene in SL biosynthesis.
Carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase 8; produces carlactone, the SL precursor.

Cytochrome P450 converting carlactone to carlactonoic acid; sorghum SbMAX1a-d. Placed downstream of MAX4 (carlactone is the SbCCD8 product and the SbMAX1 substrate) on the restored E043 citation 10.1111/nph.17737, verified in that paper's open-access full text.
Methylates carlactonoic acid to methyl carlactonoate, the LBO substrate.
2-oxoglutarate dioxygenase producing the bioactive branching-suppressing SL species.
Hydrolyses strigolactone, setting the degradation side of the SL pool balance.
Carotenoid-derived hormone that suppresses axillary bud outgrowth; pool set by LBO/MAX4 synthesis vs CXE turnover.
SL receptor; with the MAX2/D3 F-box forms the SCF complex that degrades SMXL678.
F-box component of the SCF-MAX2 complex; obligate co-receptor partner of D14.

Composite of the redundant D53/SMXL6-7-8 repressors; degraded by D14+MAX2, represses BRC1 and SPL9/15. MODELING RISK: its only activator is FHY3FAR1 (N022/E041), which is Arabidopsis-only and Step 1.6 quarantined; real D53/SMXL turnover is post-translational via the D14-MAX2 gate, so fhy3/far1 or light perturbations collapse this node further than the literature supports. See network.json metadata.modeling_risks.
SPL transcription factors that directly activate BRC1/TB1 transcription; repressed by SMXL678 and FHY3/FAR1.
Red/far-red photoreceptor; in sorghum active PHYB represses TB1/BRC1 and permits tiller bud outgrowth.
bHLH factors that activate BRC1 under low R:FR; destabilised when phytochrome is active.

annotations.fn: FAR-RED ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL3 / FAR-RED IMPAIRED RESPONSE1
annotations.desc: Transposase-derived TF pair linking light quality to the SL module (SMXL678 up, SPL9/15 down). Arabidopsis-only, Step 1.6 quarantined evidence on a Sorghum bicolor network; it is SMXL678's sole activator, so predictions for fhy3/far1 perturbations are low-confidence. See network.json metadata.modeling_risks.
TCP master repressor of axillary bud outgrowth; integrator of SL, light, sugar and cytokinin inputs.
Homeodomain factor acting downstream of TB1/BRC1 to enforce axillary bud dormancy.
Rate-limiting ABA biosynthesis enzyme; source node in this model.
Dormancy hormone that blocks bud release.
Polar auxin efflux carrier enabling auxin export from the axillary bud.
Apical auxin in the main stem; the apical dominance signal.
Auxin produced/exported by the bud; canalisation of bud auxin into the stem sustains outgrowth.
Bud-activating hormone; represses BRC1 and promotes bud auxin export.
Suppresses tiller number in cereals.
Bud-available sugar; the fastest decapitation signal, repressing BRC1 and promoting bud release.
Removal of the shoot apex: lowers apical auxin and redirects sucrose to axillary buds.

annotations.fn: High red:far-red ratio (low density / open canopy)
annotations.desc: Light quality signal activating PHYB and destabilising PIFs.
Canopy shade signal inactivating PHYB and FHY3/FAR1.
Process node: transition of the axillary bud from dormancy to sustained outgrowth.
Number of tillers produced per plant - the modelled phenotype.
